title: Mount Sinai Health System, I'm Also Notifying The Internet That Your Website is ADA Non-Compliant
subtitle: Generative Compliance is here, and it's not happy about non-compliance.
text:
In my previous post, I complained about my bill. And I use GPT-4 to help me with it.

Subscribe now

It turns out, their website is also not compliant with this ADA. This complaint has already been filed with them as well, and will be with the state.

But the trolling for public shame will continue until the health system improves. I know you just got a post from me about complaining about the compliance of the bill, but this is the speed with which compliance issues can be brought today.
